text: Answer: Bled Island Church / Church of the Assumption (Slovenia)

5. In a dry valley, there stands a Nabataean monument often overshadowed by the more famous façade of Petra. Unlike Petra’s Treasury, however, this tomb sits more isolated, almost like a lone desert cousin carved into sandstone. Built for a ruler and decorated with a monumental front, it became globally familiar again through modern tourism and photography. Which landmark is this?
